##  

Customers can interact with AI agents in their preferred language across various digital and
      voice channels. Webex AI Agent Studio supports multiple languages, allowing the AI agents to
      understand customer input and respond in the same language. 

You can create and configure an AI agent in the desired language and voice and make one as
      default, based on the requirements. 

- Autonomous AI agent

- Scripted AI agent

Based on the chosen AI engine, you can configure only one language at a time, but you can
      change it to another language, as needed. For more information, see the  Configure conversation settings section in the Webex AI Agent Studio
      Administration guide.

The following table lists the languages and voices supported for autonomous AI agents:

- The Webex AI agent configured in hi-IN, en-SG, and fil-PH can handle conversations in
            Hinglish, Singlish and Taglish respectively.

- Beta language support is limited; however, there are no billing limits applied per
            organization.

For scripted AI agents, you can configure multiple languages simultaneously and set one
      language as the default. For more information, see the  Configure language and voice section in the Set up
        scripted AI agent topic.

      Supported language models

Webex AI Agent Studio supports Polymatch and Language Encoder multilingual
      models for training scripted AI agents. These models are available as part of the Webex AI
        Agent Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch)  AI engine's settings. 

- 
        
For an AI agent trained using Polymatch, a distinct model is created for each language
          and added to the AI agent. The AI engine performs inference based on the language of the
          customer query. 

- 
        
The Language Encoder model performs best for training data on long utterances, while
          Polymatch does the same for short utterances. 

- 
        
The languages supported by Polymatch and the Language Encoder differ. For more
          information, refer to the following table. 

      Accuracy and Performance

- 
        
The accuracy and performance of an AI agent trained with the Webex AI Agent Pro 2.0
            (with Swiftmatch) model depend on advanced generative AI capabilities integrated
          during the training phase and the semantic analysis of incoming user messages. The key
          features that determine its language support and intent accuracy include:

- 

              Text and Script Support: Comprehensive support for the target language and its
              specific script, ensuring the engine can process global communication effectively.

- 

              LLM-generated Linguistic Patterns: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to
              interpret a vast array of phrasing variations. This allows the agent to accurately
              classify intents even when the user's input does not exactly match the training
              data.

- 

              Semantic Intent Classification: Moving beyond simple keyword matching, this
              feature uses advanced algorithms to understand the underlying meaning and context of a
              query, significantly reducing the impact of ambiguous language.

- 

              Adaptive Generalization: The ability of the model to effectively generalize
              across similar utterances, which minimizes the need for exhaustive manual examples
              while maintaining high precision during inference.
